title.zh: 【某休眠第三方 MakerDAO 清算机器人代理遭提取 200 枚 WETH，损失约 53.8 万美元】
title.en: 【某休眠第三方 MakerDAO 清算机器人代理遭提取 200 枚 WETH，损失约 53.8 万美元】

current_state.zh: An unauthenticated withdraw function in a dormant third-party MakerDAO ETH-A liquidation keeper proxy allowed an attacker to claim 200 WETH (~$538K) from four undealt 2020 auctions via deal(), Vat.flux and GemJoin.exit.
current_state.en: An unauthenticated withdraw function in a dormant third-party MakerDAO ETH-A liquidation keeper proxy allowed an attacker to claim 200 WETH (~$538K) from four undealt 2020 auctions via deal(), Vat.flux and GemJoin.exit.
